[documentation-forward] The // region: Icon type methods and // endregion IDE fold comments currently sit inside the marker zone. They will be consumed and replaced by the builder on first composer rebuild-icons run. This is expected behaviour (mirrors UI_Icon.php which has no region comments inside its marker zone), but should be noted in the module documentation so contributors are not surprised when the fold comments disappear after regeneration.

summary: Added a '## Code Generation' subsection to the CustomIcon class docblock in assets/classes/Maileditor/CustomIcon.php. The addition documents: (1) the START/END METHODS marker zone is auto-generated by composer rebuild-icons from themes/custom-icons.json; (2) manual edits within the marker zone will be overwritten on rebuild; (3) IDE fold comments (// region: / // endregion) inside the zone are not preserved by the generator and will be removed on first regeneration — this is expected. No external README or module docs were created; the class docblock is the most discoverable location for this maintenance note since there is no dedicated Maileditor module README.
